# Bundled Markdown editor

Vditor 4.0.0 browser distribution, copied unchanged from the npm package:
https://registry.npmjs.org/vditor/-/vditor-4.0.0.tgz

Package SHA-1: d22c501e06b3aa724e87f8d114794e1ece52f64c

Only the editor, stylesheet, Chinese translations, icons, Lute runtime and light content stylesheet are included. OpenMind uses instant rendering with a hidden toolbar and disabled browser cache. All editor resources load from this directory; no CDN or package installation is required at runtime or build time.

Vditor: https://github.com/Vanessa219/vditor — MIT, see LICENSE.
Lute: https://github.com/88250/lute — MulanPSL-2.0, see LUTE-LICENSE.
Bundled diff-match-patch: https://github.com/google/diff-match-patch — Apache-2.0, see DIFF-MATCH-PATCH-LICENSE and NOTICE.

Code blocks display as editable text. Optional diagram, media and math preview engines are not bundled.
